_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: Candidate D — the member experience. Cross-cutting: one compact staging strip with the full sentence on Build details; a shared option row for every guided decision (radio semantics, selection not carried by colour alone, stable height); global Open Graph and Twitter share metadata with canonical, theme colour, icons, a manifest and a branded 1200x630 image (no route-specific data); a mobile acceptance suite over three phone contexts using real touch and wheel scrolling. Screens: signed-in Home leads with your communities and each card's next action; Start your community and goal creation are guided decisions with truthful joining copy, the browser's own date-and-time control and a review before committing; Join explains what joining means and always offers a way out; Community Home leads with the goal, and invitation, link rotation and leaving move into an Invite card and Manage. Admission copy states only what the code enforces. On top of candidate B (65d258d) and candidate C (fcb83f7).
_expectedPriorFunctionsNote: The WSF inventory staging is expected to carry BEFORE this deployment: 24 functions = the 23-function state Package E left (22 pre-Package-E functions plus wsfSetGoalDisplayAuthorization) PLUS wsfGoalRecentAdditions, which staging run 3 (35362036618, 2026-09-18) created before its invoker-policy failure aborted that deploy (its invoker policy was never set). Run 4 (35368478133) correctly refused to deploy against the stale 23 baseline. Evidence for the 24: run 3's deploy log shows exactly the 23 reviewed functions updated and exactly one created; verify-deployment.mjs still requires the post-deploy inventory to equal its 24 expected names (anything else fails as 'present but not expected'), expects wsfGoalRecentAdditions as a created service, and reports its transport. Candidate D (a3496eb) changes only apps/westayfit app files, browser specs, scripts/westayfit/inject_meta.py, new apps/westayfit/public brand assets and docs: `git diff 65d258d a3496eb -- functions-westayfit firestore.rules firestore.indexes.json` is empty, so the prior count stays 24 and the post-deploy inventory must still equal the same 24 names; wsfGoalPulse keeps its nine-field contract. Reviewed per candidate; the next package will have a different prior count.
